newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets were quiet, with no reported sales near midday Thursday, market sources said.

A few bids of $101.00 per cwt on a dressed basis were passed by owners asking $102.00 to $103.00. Last sales were Wednesday at $100.00 to $101.00, with a few loads of mostly choice at $101.50 to $102.00.
Owners also were asking $63.00 to $64.00 on a live basis, with no reported bids or sales.
Sales for the week in Nebraska were estimated near 70,000, below the estimated showlist of about 87,000.
